summary: Omeros Corporation filed an 8-K reporting the repurchase and retirement of $30.5 million aggregate principal amount of its 9.50% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029 through privately negotiated agreements. The latest repurchase of approximately $14.5 million principal was completed on July 20, 2026, for $29.0 million total including accrued interest. Combined with a prior $16.0 million repurchase, $40.3 million in notes remain outstanding. The company directly reduced debt, with no board recommendation or advisors named. The transaction reduces future interest obligations and overhang. Watch for further opportunistic debt reduction or potential equity conversion dynamics.
